question: At the qualified R10 transition from budget 107 to 108, is restoration caused by novel phase-anchored context support in the 27 final records rather than by record-count growth alone?
hypothesis: The actual 108-prefix will reproduce full restoration because at least one of its 27 final records adds previously absent anchored support, while a fixed-size sham arm that replaces every final record with an exact duplicate of that surface's sample-107 record will remain identical in support and class structure to budget 107 despite also containing 108 records per surface.

prior_evidence.observation: Budgets 104 through 107 each induced 10 classes, eight correct triplets, one split triplet, minimum 15 contexts per surface, and maximum same-entity support difference one. Budget 108 induced nine correct triplets, zero splits, minimum 16 contexts, and zero same-entity support difference; first_restored_budget was 108.

scope_statement: This experiment changes one dimension from the R10 107-to-108 transition: support novelty of the final per-surface record. It holds record count at 108 in the actual and sham arms, preserves all R6-R10 streams, motifs, seeds, representation, induction, capacity, and audit, and makes no population, task-learning, or language-competence claim.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, CKB-plane, or cross-lane authority

arms_and_inputs.budget107_control: Exact first 107 records of each of the 27 frozen independent entity-family streams.
arms_and_inputs.actual108_control: Exact first 108 records of each frozen stream; the 27 added records are sample index 107 (zero-based) and must reproduce R10 budget 108.
arms_and_inputs.sham108_arm: For each surface, exact first 107 records followed by a byte-identical copy of that same surface's sample index 106 record; exactly 27 duplicate additions and zero intended novel-support additions.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Exact support-set deltas, class cardinality, and evaluator-only entity-membership audit; no task model is trained.

seeds.all_arms: Exact R6-R10 independent seeds. The sham introduces no random draw and duplicates a preregistered within-surface record position.

controls: Budget 107 and actual 108 must exactly reproduce R10's frozen class, triplet, split, collision, record-count, and support-range results.
Both 108-record arms add exactly one record to each surface and therefore have identical record cardinality.
Every sham addition must byte-equal that surface's sample-107 record (one-based) and add no new exact anchored-support tuple.
All arms use identical selected motifs, phase coordinate, exact support representation, class inducer, and evaluator.
Entity and family labels are unavailable to induction and enter only the post-induction audit.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The local deterministic R10 probe reproduces frozen 107 and 108 controls before R11 output is emitted.
Budget 107 is an exact per-surface prefix of actual 108 and of sham 108; all 27 sham additions exactly match their preregistered within-surface source record.
Support novelty is counted by comparing exact five-byte anchored tuples within the same surface before class induction.
Every surface has its frozen record count; all context indices and bytes are in range; all 36 unordered entity pairs are audited once per arm.
All metrics are finite and full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, task training, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, threshold change, seed search, adaptive record selection, or evaluator leakage occurs.

classification_rules.novel_support_causality_supported: Validity and controls pass; actual 108 has at least one novel support addition and is fully restored; sham 108 has exactly zero novel support additions and exactly reproduces budget 107's non-restored class structure.
classification_rules.record_count_only_supported: Validity and controls pass; sham 108 fully restores despite zero novel support additions.
classification_rules.novel_support_not_sufficient: Validity and controls pass; actual 108 adds novel support but fails frozen full restoration.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass, but results satisfy none of the preceding scientific rules.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Budget 107 or actual 108 fails any frozen R10 threshold, or sham construction/prefix cardinality fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents all three frozen arms.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, support accounting, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on parent, North Star, R10 replication, sham construction, build, or frozen-package drift.
After R11 output begins, complete all three arms and all frozen evaluations unless infrastructure prevents it.

Do not change the sham source position, inspect alternate duplicates, add arms, or alter representation, controls, metrics, thresholds, budgets, capacity, or classification after observing R11 output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No arm, duplicate source, budget, context distribution, sample sequence, seed, representation rule, class learner, control, metric, threshold, capacity, stop condition, or interpretation may change after primary R11 output.
